rollback.instructions: Revert only the files listed in scope.allowedWritePaths (astronautForm/AstronautModel.tsx, index.tsx, AngularAstronautModelHost.tsx, any additions under astronautForm/__tests__, the new astronaut-form Angular folder, the new shared/components details/radio-button/icons/flex/text files, and the new core/store and core/bridges/drawlib/floor-plan-maker/element-creation-manager files) to their state at revision 03bb7e90a09b1e56b75801d03d7eb349828f0b59. No package.json changes were made, so no npm install is needed after reverting.

limitations: Every shared Angular component (details, radio-button, radio-button-group, flex, text, icon) exposes plain public signal fields (e.g. `isOpen`, `active`) and classic @ViewChild()-based composition from ngAfterViewChecked(), instead of this project's usual input()/output() signal helpers, for genuine component-to-component composition: empirically (confirmed against this exact component during this run, evidenced by NG0303 template-binding failures and a modelChanged/checked-state that silently never refreshed), a *nested* Angular component's signal-based input()/output() fields never receive their compiled metadata under this repository's actual pure-JIT compilation (no ngtsc/AOT build step is installed), so a parent template's [prop]/(event) binding to them never resolves, and a signal effect() reading a later-materializing @ViewChild is not reliable either. input()/output() remain correct for AstronautModelComponent's own adapter boundary (set via setAdapterInputs(), read via modelChanged.subscribe() from mount-astronaut-model.ts, matching line-fields.component.ts's precedent), since that is never bound to from another Angular template. This is a repository-level constraint every future slice that composes more than one Angular component will also hit, not something specific to this flow; the project-constants.md#Compilation `hostTokenStyle`/hostTokenStyle-based static-styles convention was likewise never observed anywhere in the existing lineForm/angular/ code and was implemented here as CSS custom properties bound through `host` instead of `${...}` template interpolation.

A manually created and `applicationRef.attachView()`-attached root component (this project's only mounting pattern, since there is no Analog/AOT build step) does not reliably re-run change detection on its own once a signal changes after the first check; mount-astronaut-model.ts's applyInputs() forces two synchronous componentRef.changeDetectorRef.detectChanges() passes on every setAdapterInputs() call (initial mount, host-driven updates, and its own modelChanged-triggered self-refresh) to make this deterministic rather than depend on the zoneless scheduler's own timing.

Only the light-mode design token variant is ported for every new shared component (no dark theme), matching this repository's only other Angular slice, line-fields.component.ts, which does not support dark mode either.

RadioButtonGroupComponent's hover/active background suppression while `disabled` was simplified to omit the `:not([aria-disabled="true"])` exclusion RadioButtonGroup.tsx has, since this flow's seven radios never pass `disabled`.
Per-flow coverage was not retrieved this run (testGaps); CI computes it via npm run test:ci.

floor-plan-stores.store.ts and the element-creation-manager history bridge are also being built in parallel by detail-drawer-straight-strip-form in its own worktree (flow-contract.json decisions); whichever of the two lands second resolves the merge conflict by reusing the already-landed files.

characterization.test: src/features/floorPlanCreator/detailDrawer/astronautForm/__tests__/AstronautModel.characterization.test.tsx (run against the pre-migration React AstronautModel.tsx before it was replaced by the Angular-hosting wrapper, then removed once the replacement landed; the same reset-to-first-subtype behavior is re-asserted post-migration in astronaut-model.component.spec.ts's A5/A3 subtype tests and AngularAstronautModelHost.test.tsx's select-a5-model test)
characterization.note: Clicking the A5 (or A3) group radio unconditionally sets the model to A5IFlow (or A3Regular), confirmed by switching away to A4 first (so the click actually fires a change event) and back, even though a different A5/A3 subtype was active before switching away.

characterization.test: src/features/floorPlanCreator/detailDrawer/astronautForm/__tests__/AstronautModel.characterization.test.tsx (run against the pre-migration React AstronautModel.tsx, then removed; re-asserted post-migration in astronaut-model.component.spec.ts's sections-reset-open-on-remount test, which mounts a fresh AstronautModelComponent instance and checks both Details start expanded)
characterization.note: Collapsing the Model/Type sections and then remounting (a fresh component instance, matching the host's astronautId-keyed remount) always re-expands both sections, since AstronautModelComponent's modelOpen/typeOpen signals are freshly initialized to true on every construction, matching AstronautModel.tsx's useState(true).

observations: AngularAstronautModelHost.test.tsx renders the real AstronautForm (index.tsx) parent tree with AstronautSide's Configuration Left/Right radios rendered for real (not stubbed), confirming the migrated Model/Type sections sit directly below Configuration without displacing it, matching index.tsx:29-45's existing order.

The retained Angle/Done/Delete siblings (stubbed for isolation) and the isPlaced-gated Distances/Coordinates stubs all continue to render alongside the Angular host in every scenario, confirming the migrated slice never returns early from or hides the parent form.

The Angular radios reuse the same tabIndex sequence as the pre-migration React radios (2-4 for Model, 5-7/5-6 for Type), continuing tab order from the retained Configuration/Angle fields per visualParity.layout.

Details' Summary header ported declaration by declaration from Details.tsx:55-63/39 (cursor:pointer, list-style:none, user-select:none, margin-bottom:8px, margin-top:16px) plus the caret-up/caret-down chevron swap on toggle, using literal inline <svg> markup copied from @lely/icons/src/assets/caret-up.svg and caret-down.svg (fill hardcoded to currentColor), never a bound [innerHTML], per Icon.tsx:81-127 and the flow contract's decision that Icon is an undeclared transitive prerequisite of Details.

RadioButtonGroup's bordered fieldset row (border, 4px radius, white background, neutral._99/._90 hover/active backgrounds) and RadioButton/RadioButtonBase's 24x24 circle-and-dot control (border width/radius, background, hover/focus-visible/disabled border colors, checked dot) are ported token-by-token from RadioButtonGroup.tsx:6-33 and RadioButtonBase.tsx:37-119 via @lely/tokens/enums, applied as CSS custom properties through a host binding rather than interpolated into the static styles string, per project-constants.md#Compilation.

Label text uses LelyFontFamily.UBUNTU/LelyFontWeight.REGULAR/LelyFontSize.BASE/LelyLineHeight.XL/LelyTextColorLight.DEFAULT, matching RadioButton.tsx:44-54's token set (light-mode only, see limitations).

Column direction (radios stack vertically per group) and no additional padding beyond the existing FormWrapper vertical rhythm were both preserved: RadioButtonGroupComponent defaults to direction 'column' and DetailsComponent adds only the 8px/16px margins Details.tsx itself declares.

Not independently re-verified against the manual Route Assistant desktop environment in this run: per-pixel appearance in the real WebView, and Section width matching the retained Configuration section's content width, are flow-verify's manual validation to confirm.
